dsh-skill-curator is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Meta-skill for DSH skill experience feedback and knowledge accumulation: feeds fixes back into skills and records a searchable knowledge base (keyword + local bge semantic retrieval, 7-point write-back checklist, anti-bloat archiving), with self-validation and event-hook tools.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-110643a0d87934802285.html
